prose: Tonight we bull-rush into the Spring and continue the Astro-Herbalism series, exploring the plant signatures that tell the tale of Taurus' virtues. Returning to enlighten us are Kyle Denton (Tippecanoe Herbs), Michelle Lundquist (Michelle's Healing Home), and Mario Garza (Symbolic Studies). Expect beautiful blossoms of wisdom!
